dct_title_s: Johnson's Map of New York and the Adjacent Cities
dct_description_sm: Shows streets, wards, and railroads for New York City and parts of Brooklyn, Jersey City, and Hoboken; shows buildings on Blackwells Island
Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian
Inset map: -- [1] Continuation of the City & County of New York on a reduced scale
